name: canonical/storage/2^26-letters
note: a frame of decoded length 2^26 (an IRI of the letters A to Z, each the byte b of an MT19937 stream taken as the letter chr(65 + b % 26)); the stored bytes are kept in the file when they are at most 20 MB

result.construction: the payload of one terms frame (order canonical, restart_group 64) of the one IRI http://e/a followed by an IRI of 67108836 letters, so that the decoded length is 2^26: the generator MT19937 initialised by init_by_array with the key [11], each 32-bit output written as four bytes in little-endian order, and each byte b taken as the letter chr(65 + b % 26)
result.stored_file: removed: above 20 MB; the digest and the length are the vector
